implementationProposal: One optional narrow base-city display association: exact approved pair and proof; singleton source/base inventories; exact source/effective residential tags and shapes; primary Arabic and governorate match; base and reviewed settlement both inside original+packed footprint; raw nearest default equals existing base; preserve all IDs/names/contexts/coordinates/defaults/geometry. Point kinds and coordinate differences must be explicit. Do not require invented whole-city geometry, borrow a coded sector identity, or add a transitive/proximity rule.
limitations: This is a source/data proposal, not permission to import a generalized method or certify urban perimeters.
City-only cached nodes are currently excluded from the compiler. Their historical evidence must be bound explicitly before implementation.
Historical source/phone reports retain their own metadata hashes; target current fields and packed geometry were independently compared here.
No new web/API requests, PBF/source scans, tests, generation, phone/ledger access or repository edits were performed.
